title: Simple Text Editor for Business Central
summary: A lightweight AL extension provides a simple text editor dialog for Business Central users to edit and store longer plain text notes in BLOB fields without complex formatting. It solves the limitation of cramped multi-line fields by opening a clean modal editor accessible via ribbon actions on customer lists and cards.
key_points: Addresses the gap for plain text editing in Business Central by providing a modal dialog for BLOB field text storage
Minimal design with no formatting controls, intentionally designed for basic text entry and pasting
Easily reusable across any table with a BLOB field by following three basic setup steps
Positioned as a lightweight alternative to rich text editors and complex documentation systems

quotes.text: Just plain text, saved in a field, opened with a single action.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core purpose and simplicity of the solution

quotes.text: The smallest possible building block that solves the "long plain text in a BLOB" problem.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the intentional minimalism and positioning relative to richer alternatives

quotes.text: You can reuse the same pattern for any place where you already use (or plan to use) a BLOB field for text.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the reusability and generic nature of the implementation
